features.name: project_qemu_indicator
features.description: Indicator variable for the 'qemu' project, mapped to -1.0 and 1.0 for SVM margin optimization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a linear shift in the decision boundary based on the project domain, allowing the SVM to learn project-specific base rates.

features.name: project_ffmpeg_indicator
features.description: Indicator variable for the 'FFmpeg' project, mapped to -1.0 and 1.0 for SVM margin optimization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows the linear model to adjust its intercept for FFmpeg-specific code patterns.

features.name: id_standardized
features.description: Standardized version of the row ID, centered and scaled using training set mean and standard deviation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ensures the numeric ID feature is on a similar scale to other features, preventing it from dominating the SVM margin penalty.

features.name: func_cyclomatic_complexity_score
features.description: Semantic estimation of the cyclomatic complexity of the C/C++ function, counting branching statements like if, for, while, and switch cases, normalized to a continuous score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a continuous severity measure of control flow complexity, which often correlates linearly with bug density.

features.name: func_pointer_arithmetic_risk
features.description: Assessment of the intensity and risk of pointer arithmetic and direct memory access operations within the function.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous risk score for memory-related vulnerabilities, highly relevant for linear separation in C/C++ code analysis.

features.name: func_memory_management_risk
features.description: Evaluation of manual memory management complexity, including allocations, deallocations, and buffer size calculations.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures the likelihood of memory leaks or use-after-free issues as a smooth normalized score.

features.name: func_error_handling_ratio
features.description: Ratio of error handling and logging code (e.g., goto fail, return error codes) relative to the total function logic.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a ratio feature that helps the SVM distinguish between robustly written functions and those lacking proper error checks.

features.name: func_length_chars_log
features.description: Logarithmic scale of the total number of characters in the function source code, capturing function size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a heavily skewed length metric into a smooth, linearly separable feature suitable for SVMs.

features.name: func_api_call_density
features.description: Density of external API or function calls per line of code, indicating the level of abstraction and external dependencies.
features.expected_model_benefit: Offers a normalized ratio of external interactions, useful for modeling the attack surface of the function.

features.name: func_bitwise_operations_intensity
features.description: Intensity of bitwise operations (AND, OR, XOR, shifts) used in the function, common in low-level parsing and cryptography.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights low-level data manipulation patterns, providing a continuous feature for the SVM to weight parsing-related risks.

features.name: func_loop_depth_max
features.description: Maximum nesting depth of loops within the function, reflecting algorithmic complexity and potential performance bottlenecks.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a bounded integer-like continuous feature representing structural depth, useful for linear combinations with complexity scores.

features.name: func_condition_complexity
features.description: Average number of boolean operators (&&, ||) per conditional statement, indicating the complexity of control flow decisions.
features.expected_model_benefit: Acts as a continuous severity measure of decision logic complexity, aiding the linear model in identifying convoluted conditions.
